books.title: Emotional Detox: 7 Steps to Release Toxicity and Energize Joy
books.author: Sherianna Boyle
books.description: The first book of her series, setting out the seven steps of her Cleanse Method for meeting difficult feelings in the body instead of thinking them over. It explains what an emotional cleanse is and how to practise one in daily life. Editions exist in Chinese, Turkish and German.

books.title: Emotional Detox for Anxiety: 7 Steps to Release Toxicity and Energize Joy
books.author: Sherianna Boyle
books.description: A follow-up that applies the seven-step Cleanse Method to anxious feelings, seeing anxiety as emotion that has not yet been allowed to move through. Short practices help readers let go of negative patterns and make room for calmer habits.

books.title: The Four Gifts of Anxiety: Embrace the Power of Your Anxiety and Transform Your Life
books.author: Sherianna Boyle
books.description: A book of exercises and meditations that reframes anxious feelings as carrying four strengths: resilience, hope, empathy and purpose. Readers learn to turn worry into a prompt for growth and steadier self-trust.

courses.title: Moon Detox Events
courses.description: Four two-hour live Zoom gatherings a year, one per season, that pair a guided emotional cleanse led by Sherianna with seasonal and birth-chart astrology from her co-host Carmen. Each session closes with intention-setting and manifestation practices, and a week of replay access is included.

free_resources.title: 7 Simple Questions to Help You Release Anxiety and Increase Joy
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide of seven short questions for moving out of anxious, stuck or overwhelmed feelings towards a calmer sense of freedom. It is given in exchange for an email address.

left_out: The Conscious Parent's Guide to Childhood Anxiety and The Everything Parent's Guide to Overcoming Childhood Anxiety: parenting guides for children diagnosed with anxiety ('with proper care and treatment... overcome paralyzing anxiety'); clinical treatment framing, and not spiritual teaching.
Emotional Detox Podcast: mostly interviews with guests, so not her own teaching (scope, not health).

'Reduce Triggers - Emotional Detox Tips' and 'Which Emotional Detox Book Do I Start With?': no page found on her site (likely videos or the /quiz page, which is only a results menu); videos are handled separately.
